title: Kind Ruth
textBlocks:
Kind Ruth meets Kind Boaz
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story 
you will hear how 
kind Ruth was to her husband’s mom

When Naomi’s husband and sons died, she told Ruth to go home to her mom.
But Ruth wouldn’t leave Naomi alone.
Naomi and Ruth went back to Bethlehem, a long way away.

In Bethlehem Ruth picked up scraps from the farms. 
The farmer noticed her and found out just how kind she had been to Naomi.
He told his workers to help her.

Boaz married Ruth. 
And they had a baby called Obed.

Ruth was KIND to Naomi 
and then
Boaz was KIND to Ruth
Can you match the question to the picture?
Download, print and follow the lines to the right answer

Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for caring for us
Please help me to be kind to other people
My dad, my mom, 
my sisters, my brothers
and my friends 
AMEN
